doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Studio work, Rudy Van Gelder and Freddie Hubbard
title: The Mingus Let My Children Hear Music credit
summary: Brown notes Lord lists Laws on a 1971 Mingus date. Laws suggests he played a Sebesky chart without knowing it was Mingus's record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: We going to have to – I’m going to let Tom Lord know. He’s got you listed in the orchestra for Let My Children Hear Music for Mingus, New York, September 23rd, 1971, but your recollection is that you didn’t play with Mingus. But . . .
No, no, I just don’t remember him . . .
It may have been a Don Sebesky-type thing where he wrote the chart, and I came in and played it without knowing it was a Mingus record.
